rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: The INC's past-president page says Smt. Sonia Gandhi took the primary membership of the party in 1997, entered public life shortly before the 1998 Lok Sabha elections and 'became the President of the Indian National Congress Party in April 1998', and calls her the longest serving President of the party.
